result.root_cause_analysis: The 4 HLS IPs (T0024 xmod_attn, T0025 gvsa, T0026 adh, T0029 vit) were exported from vitis_hls with the default ap_memory interface on all top-level array function-args (Q[4096], K[256][4096], V[256][4096], W_time[128*256], etc.). HLS's ARRAY_PARTITION cyclic+block pragmas split each array into 32-128 sub-banks, each becoming a separate IP-XACT busInterface group (Q_0_address0 / Q_0_q0 / Q_0_ce0 ...). component.xml of xmod_attn_v1 alone contains 1674 spirit:name entries — almost all signal-level ap_memory ports.
why_the_AXI_NoC_fix_doesnt_apply_in_TCL: The orchestrator task spec assumes the IPs expose AXI master ports (m_axi) that could be routed through a NoC. They DO NOT. They expose ap_memory BRAM-style ports.

To absorb 3094 ap_memory ports we would need 3094 axi_bram_ctrl instances (one per address/data/ce group), wired through SmartConnect/NoC to memory controllers. That is not feasible in a TCL script; even Vivado GUI would take days of manual wiring.

The actual fix is at the HLS source: change top-level array args from default ap_memory to `#pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=K bundle=ddrK offset=slave`. Each array then exposes a SINGLE m_axi master that the BD can route through NoC->DDR. But the task explicitly forbids HLS source changes.

human_ack_reasons: io_overutilization_again — same root cause as T0036_RETRY impl failure. The TCL-level AXI NoC fix proposed by the task spec doesn't apply because the HLS IPs export ap_memory, not m_axi. Resolving this requires either re-running HLS with #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi on K/V/W arrays (forbidden by task) or weeks of manual axi_bram_ctrl wiring in GUI.

Paper-level recommendation: keep T0036_RETRY synth numbers as the [HW-SYNTH] row of Table V (already accepted by ACK 5acc135). Treat the integrated [HW-IMPL] post-route as future work explicitly outside the FCCM/DAC scope.
v3a_followup_paths: Path A (recommended): re-package HLS IPs (T0024, T0025, T0026, T0029) with m_axi top-level interface on all array args. This is a 1-line pragma addition per array, but is forbidden by T0036_v3 task spec. Would need a new task explicitly authorizing it.
Path B: build a TCL generator that inspects each IP's interface list and emits one axi_bram_ctrl + SmartConnect mapping per ap_memory bank. Multi-day automation effort; not a pure 1-shot script.
Path C: accept T0036_RETRY synth-only as paper's authoritative integrated number (matches T0036_RETRY ACK reasoning); skip impl entirely for camera-ready.
v0_paper_publishable: YES — T0036_RETRY synth-only [HW-SYNTH] row is already ACCEPTED for Table V per ACK 5acc135. T0036_v3 attempts post-route upgrade but architecturally cannot complete without HLS source changes that the task forbids.
next_task_suggestion: Either authorize HLS source m_axi-pragma additions (new task) or accept synth-only as final. T0042 (T0041 v1.1a follow-up) is independent and can proceed.
